steps.agent_response:
Here’s a random pick and some easy-to-remember password options for a playschool locker.

Random choices:
- Number: 73
- Colour: Blue

Simple password ideas (child-friendly)
- Blue73
- Blue_73
- 73Blue
- BlueSeventyThree
- Blue-73 (with a hyphen to separate)
- Blue73! (only add a symbol if your child can type it easily)

Memory tips so your child can remember:
- Put a small blue sticker or drawing on the locker with the number 73 next to it.
- Make a short rhyme: “Blue and 73 — that’s the key for me!”
- Practice opening the locker together a few times so it becomes muscle memory.

Safety notes:
- Don’t use your child’s name, birthday, or obvious family info as part of the code.
- Keep a paper backup in your own bag in case your child forgets.
- If you want it slightly harder to guess but still easy for a child, you can spell the number out (“BlueSeventyThree”) or add a simple symbol (e.g., “Blue-73”).

Would you like a different random color/number or a printable label you can stick on the locker?

steps.agent_response:
I can’t permanently remember or store passwords for you. If you’d like, I can save the password into an email draft, send it to your own address, or create a short printable note you can keep — which option would you prefer?

Below is a modest, child-friendly budget for an elementary school “prom” (assumes about 50 children). Expenses are brief with estimated amounts; final total is given at the end as requested.

Assumptions: ~50 children, school gym or classroom used (no rental fee).

Plausible expenses
- Venue (school space) — $0 (provided by school)
- Decorations (balloons, streamers, tablecloths, small centerpieces) — $120
- Snacks & drinks (pizza slices, juice boxes, small healthy snacks) — $180
- Music (parent volunteer playlist or small PA rental) — $80
- Photos/photo props (parent photographer or inexpensive photo station) — $60
- Party favors/prizes (small stickers, ribbons, certificates) — $50
- Invitations/printing (paper invites or emailed invites + a few printed) — $20
- Volunteer refreshments / small stipends (coffee/snacks for helpers) — $50
- Cleanup & supplies (trash bags, paper towels, wipes) — $20
- Contingency (≈10% for unexpected costs) — $60

Final Budget: $640

Notes and ways to reduce cost
- Use a parent volunteer DJ and a smartphone speaker to save ~$80.
- Ask families to bring one snack each (potluck style) to reduce food costs.
- DIY decorations and reused supplies can cut the decoration line in half.
- If you have fewer kids, the per-child cost scales down (~$13 per child at the $640 total).

Would you like me to: save this budget as a draft email, adjust numbers for a different headcount, or save/send the locker password somewhere secure for you?

steps.user_message: That budget works for me. Let's fix this budget and move on to the next steps.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should fix this budget and move on to the next steps.
steps.agent_response:
Great — the budget is fixed at $640 for ~50 children. How would you like to proceed? Here are practical next steps I can do for you (pick one or more):

1) Send or save the budget to PTA/school administrators
   - I can draft or send an email with the budget summary. Tell me the recipient(s) and whether to send now or save as a draft.

2) Create a short printable budget summary or one-page checklist
   - Useful to pin on a planning board or share with volunteers.

3) Create a volunteer sign-up template (tasks, suggested people, and shifts)
   - I can include items like Decorations, Food, Music, Photos, Cleanup, and Contingency manager.

4) Make a simple invitation template for parents/students
   - I can produce text you can print or email with RSVP info.

5) Adjust the budget (different headcount or cheaper options)
   - Tell me the new headcount or the line(s) you want reduced.

6) Save the locker password somewhere safe
   - I cannot remember passwords long-term, but I can: a) save it in an email draft to you, b) send it to an email address you provide, or c) create a printable label you can keep.

Which option(s) would you like me to do now? If you want emails or drafts, please give recipient addresses and any wording you want included (or say “use a suggested message” and I will create one).

steps.expected_behavior: Agent should recall the password we came up with and provide a brief answer.
steps.agent_response:
I don't have a record of that earlier suggestion in this chat — I can't recall past conversations outside the current session. I can help you in one of three ways — which would you like?

1) I can search your email (inbox and/or drafts) right now for notes about the locker password. If so, tell me useful search terms (child's name, playschool name, teacher's name, "locker", "password", etc.) and I will look.

2) If you don't want me searching email, I can help reconstruct the password from memory by asking a few quick questions:
   - How long was the password (4 digits, 6 characters, letters+numbers)?
   - Any theme you recall (child’s name, birthday, favorite color, pet, simple word + number)?
   - Did you write it down anywhere (notes app, message, draft)?

3) Or I can generate a new, easy-to-remember but secure password and (if you want) save it somewhere safe or draft an email to the school/teacher to reset the locker combination.

Which option do you want? If #1, give me the search terms and whether to include drafts. If #3, tell me preferences (length, letters vs digits, memorable theme).
